description: Timeline quality canon for editorial and assembly timelines.

quality_dimensions.name: Track Integrity
quality_dimensions.description: All timeline tracks must contain valid, non-empty media.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Video, audio, and effect tracks populated with correct media.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Empty tracks, placeholder media, or broken references.

quality_dimensions.name: Duration Accuracy
quality_dimensions.description: Shot and scene durations must match approved timing.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Each shot duration within +/- 0.5s of approved timing.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Shot durations deviate significantly from approved plan.

quality_dimensions.name: Transition Quality
quality_dimensions.description: Transitions must follow approved transition policy.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: Transitions match policy. No jarring or unintended transitions.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Forbidden transition types used or transitions break continuity.

quality_dimensions.name: Marker Accuracy
quality_dimensions.description: Timeline markers must accurately reflect scene boundaries and beats.
quality_dimensions.acceptance_criteria: All required markers present at correct timecodes.
quality_dimensions.rejection_criteria: Missing markers or markers at wrong positions.
